comment: Authored provider completion for the search Layer-2 public-boundary cases. The production pipeline still assembles context, routes, retrieves, validates and delivers; only the model completion is scripted, because the seatbelt profile blocks external egress and a world with no reachable provider answers every turn with 'every configured provider failed' - a property of the sandbox, not of the system under test. The catch-all match ('' is a substring of every request) is deliberate: the restart follow-up has to be answerable or the constraint-survival assertion is unfalsifiable. The reply REPEATS the requested identifiers for the same reason. {NONCE} is substituted by the shim and bound by the harness for consumption evidence.
